mentions.name: Aisma
mentions.description: Aisma is an AI-powered video editor that edits videos by parts: users describe edits in simple requests in any language, and the tool applies changes to specific shots within a video — even sub-second shots — without charging for the whole video. Users can continue editing short parts separately if a generation is incomplete, and Aisma returns credits for portions of the video that don't contain the requested subject. It also uses a feedback loop of misunderstood videos to train how it handles such content. Available on web, iOS and Android.
mentions.problem: Existing video editors charge for the entire video even when only a short shot in the middle needs editing, and struggle with videos containing many very short shots, requiring repeated paid edits on the whole video.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Aisma is a video editor which can edit your video by parts.

Also Aisma understands very simple requests in any languages and can edit just a part of video, so no need to pay for whole video if you need to edit just something in the middle.
